name: 半枚棋子 · 人物传 VOL.6（陷阱猎人版）
desc: 2026 暑假特辑 SP7《半枚棋子》陷阱猎人版语法命门 12 题，按 R / SR / SSR 三档标注难度。本卷的看图命门（13–18）、传记阅读（19–22）、对白填空、时间线排序依赖纸面漫画分镜页，未进题库。

m5.q: Yu ___ back last Tuesday, after seventy days away.
m5.why: last Tuesday 是明确的过去时间点，用一般过去时 came。

m5.q: Let's start the game before the bell, ___?
m5.why: Let's 开头的祈使句，反意疑问固定用 shall we。

m5.q: The question of ___ Yue is still alive has no answer yet.
m5.why: 介词 of 后面接从句只能用 whether，不能用 if。

m5.q: Jin saw Yu ___ the half piece out of his pocket and press it onto the board.
m5.why: see sb do 表示看见整个动作完成；后面的 press 是原形，两个动作并列，只能同为原形。

m5.q: Duo is the only player ___ opening no one in the school has seen before.
m5.why: 横线后面是名词 opening，缺的是“他的”，用关系代词 whose。

m5.q: Duo ___ the first move until Yu sat down opposite him.
m5.why: not…until 表示“直到……才”，主句必须是否定式；全句是过去的事，用 didn't make。

m5.q: Duo often wishes Yue ___ here to see this game.
m5.why: wish 后面的从句用虚拟语气；与现在事实相反，be 动词一律用 were。

m5.q: It was kind ___ Xi to keep Yu's seat for two whole months.
m5.why: kind 是评价人品的形容词，用 It is + adj + of sb + to do。

m5.q: The board ___ before the bell, or the match doesn't count.
m5.why: 棋盘是被人收的，主语是物，用情态动词被动式 must be + 过去分词。

m5.q: ___ longer he waited, ___ quieter he became.
m5.why: “越……越……”用 the + 比较级, the + 比较级，两个 the 都不能省。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: It took Yu seventy days to find the other half.
The boy sat by the window kept his face in the dark.
Every piece on the board has its own place.
The girls' seats were kept for two whole months.
m5.why: 要表示“坐在窗边的那个男孩”，作定语要用现在分词 sitting → The boy sitting by the window…；写成 sat 就成了两个谓语。

m5.q: 下列四句中只有一句有语法错误。选出【错误】的一句：
ops: The coat had hung on that chair for two months.
Not a single word was said about Yue that afternoon.
By the time Yu came back, the game has already started.
Xi keeps three lollipops in her pocket, as she always does.
m5.why: by the time + 过去时，主句要用过去完成 → had already started。
